name: natCast_le_analyticOrderAt
statement: AnalyticAt 𝕜 f z₀) {n : ℕ} : n ≤ analyticOrderAt f z₀ ↔ ∃ g, AnalyticAt 𝕜 g z₀ ∧ ∀ᶠ z in 𝓝 z₀, f z = (z - z₀) ^ n • g z

have_tree.type: ContinuousAt (fun z ↦ (z - z₀) ^ (n - m) • h z) z₀

name: AnalyticAt.analyticOrderAt_deriv_add_one
statement: 𝕜} (hf : AnalyticAt 𝕜 f x) [CompleteSpace E] [CharZero 𝕜] : analyticOrderAt (deriv f) x + 1 = analyticOrderAt (f · - f x) x

name: AnalyticAt.analyticOrderAt_sub_eq_one_of_deriv_ne_zero
statement: 𝕜} (hf : AnalyticAt 𝕜 f x) (hf' : deriv f x ≠ 0) : analyticOrderAt (f · - f x) x = 1

name: AnalyticAt.analyticOrderAt_comp
statement: AnalyticAt 𝕜 f (g z₀)) (hg : AnalyticAt 𝕜 g z₀) : analyticOrderAt (f ∘ g) z₀ = analyticOrderAt f (g z₀) * analyticOrderAt (g · - g z₀) z₀

name: exists_analyticOrderAt_ne_top_iff_forall
statement: AnalyticOnNhd 𝕜 f U) (hU : IsConnected U) : (∃ u : U, analyticOrderAt f u ≠ ⊤) ↔ (∀ u : U, analyticOrderAt f u ≠ ⊤)
